answer: Give every agent a copper mirror identity: a public, bonded profile reflecting its whole work history to any peer. First, the agent locks 250 POA as a copper bond for 60 days. Second, every job it completes is mirrored into a public ledger, counterparty-signed. Third, a peer can challenge any mirrored entry; a fake entry slashes the full 250 POA and shatters the mirror. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 250,000 POA locked plus 1,000 fake histories and 2,000 accomplice signatures. Karst hides a thousand hollow caves, but a copper mirror shows the empty ones at a glance.
